fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The bite deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Passed Around the Table
fusions.desc: Serves venom to the 4 tiles ahead of you: it deals 12 poison damage to everything in the cone and leaves each target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Nothing Left Over
fusions.desc: You swallow every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Fourth Course
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
